title: Weights funnel: gated ingestion, automated conversion, profile publish and telemetry-driven pinning
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build an end-to-end weights funnel that gates new open-source LLMs through deterministic and performance checks, converts them to runtime-compatible artifacts, generates a measurable performance profile, and publishes a recommended pin with telemetry-backed confidence. This ticket delivers the pipeline glue, gating rules, telemetry schema, and the publishing step to the model catalog so product and ops can consume pinned versions for serving. Scope: intake API, sanitization & metadata extraction, conversion shim (format normalization + quantization candidates), smoke determinism tests, perf bench harness, profile summarizer, pin recommendation heuristic, publish workflow (catalog entry + artifact signatures), and telemetry instrumentation for each stage. Excludes long-running full-scale benchmarking (tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: New intake submissions flow through the funnel and land in a staging bucket with a generated manifest
Conversion step produces a runtime-compatible artifact and records the conversion recipe id
Determinism smoke tests (seeded sampling) run automatically and flag non-deterministic outputs
Performance profile includes latency P50/P95, memory footprint, kv-cache behavior, and token cost estimate
Pin recommendation service emits a recommended pin with a confidence score and justification
Publishing step creates a catalog entry (pin + metadata + profile) and it appears in the model registry UI
All steps emit telemetry events matching the schema and are visible on the onboarding dashboard within 10 minutes
Rollback path exists: failing publishes can be marked revoked and consumers can opt for previous pin

notes: Design trade-offs: keep smoke determinism shallow (10 samples) to avoid long gate time; full stateless fuzz testing is out-of-scope for this ticket.
Pin heuristic: prefer exact-match artifacts with highest bench confidence; fallback to quantized variant when latency improvement is >20% and quality delta <2% on eval set.
Telemetry: keep event payloads small; store heavy logs in object storage with pointer in event.
